args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back** — reverted checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions; the rollback was verified.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** — `INC-0001` for checkout-api, describing the health-check failures and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.
